query:
SELECT cfs.id, cfs.conversation_id, cfs.flow_id, cfs.current_node_id, cfs.context, cfs.status, cfs.created_at 
FROM chat_flow_sessions cfs 
JOIN conversations c ON c.id = cfs.conversation_id 
WHERE c.customer_name LIKE '%Matheus%' 
ORDER BY cfs.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
